content: Thlid Yeeso sǝ ahu mǝrra
A hu katǝrad par fara yi ɓeena mǝd, a tsar ƙǝrǝt, nishyini tǝrang ngganda kariyi ni na sǝdghǝn mbǝnggǝn, ngwana nda fa ɗǝnda tǝghǝn a ten kwadɗa ɗǝ.
Ɗa nda wal ferɗi nggǝlang na nda mii kwadɗa sǝ kwatǝrɗǝ man patu ɗǝ.
Amma kyana nda sa hai, nawa nda mǝrra Yeeso wa.
Nana nda a numarha aten ǝnɗi katǝragha hai kee, kula kanda sǝndasǝ na nafiya nda sǝri tǝ lukki ndan a chimnda fa nagha ahar yirha ƙǝƙǝt a thlǝman ndan.
Ka tǝrǝm nda, nishyini kwangganda tǝn ndan a hweeɗe hai, amma ndangga nafini kanda, “Kama nun a kaɗa tǝ yibrha, a pathlang mǝrya?
Ɓalwa a mbǝɗiya wa, thliiɗa sǝ! Ɗalama teena hai tǝ ˈya thlǝghang nǝn kun, ndǝghǝn ɓalɗǝ tǝ kun a Nggalili.
‘Wan Niifa nǝn a mukrha ahar fa ɗimiya hai, tawangganda ɗǝ, a far paara yi mahan nǝn a nggǝr thliirha sǝ.’ ”
Tǝrgha ɗal teena nda hai aten pathghǝn.
Wud nanda ɓa aten kwadɗi, pǝrang ǝnggina nda heu a Kum Kap Talɗi tǝ fingya fiya.
Nda Mairamu tǝ Magdaliya, tǝ Yowana tǝ Mairamu man Yakubu, tǝ fingya nishya nananda a mbǝɗi, kanda ni pǝrangga ndǝn fa thlǝngya Yeeso.
Amma fǝrwanda ƙǝkafek tǝ path nishyini wa, ƙeser tǝrgha nda path ndan ƙǝla ɓasharha ni.
Mbiturus thliighasǝ tawad ɗagha ten kwadɗa ɗǝ. Ɓǝrgha a mii kwadɗi ƙǝlagha sa ɗǝ, na kaɓadɗa nǝn pang nandasǝ a man patu. Wudgha, ǝnwulteena nǝn tǝ ǝnɗi katǝragha hai.
A kwaman Imawus
Nanǝnya tsu a farɗi sǝri ahur nafiya na a mbu samad Yeeso kanda a kwaman ɗǝrha ahu tala ɗǝ nanda aarha Imawus, na iundǝghǝn mel mǝd tǝ Urshelima.
Kanda a tsǝ laɓara aten ǝnggini katǝragha hai.
Na nanda a tsǝ laɓara aten ǝnggini kee, Yeeso tǝ altenggǝn ɗǝgha thlǝman ndan ɗǝ wii nda ɗǝ.
Amma nggǝlang nda yindan, amana nda kukwalang hai.
Tsahang mee nǝn kanda, “Laɓar ma nun a tsǝrha kee kun aten wiirha?” Isha nda hai ƙǝƙǝt, ƙǝlagha Yeeso hai na hur ndan sǝsǝɓa ɗǝ.
Tal ahur ndan, na thlǝmnggǝn Kilobas, tsahang mee nǝn, “Sa ndǝna ronga kee a Urshelima sǝngwa ǝnɗi katǝragha hai a mbǝɗi ahu ɓǝngginiya wa!”
Tsakh mee nǝn, “Mani ǝnggini?” Ndang ngganda, “Ənggini tsǝgha hai aten Yeeso tǝ Nadzarat. Annabini, ǝn ǝnadghǝn tǝ laɓarghǝn nǝghǝn tǝ sǝsǝmnda a mbed Faara tǝ fiya na heu.
Mamnda firistaya tǝ mamngginǝm fǝr ndan a ngwang kumad mǝrra nda, tawangganda ɗǝ.
Amma nan a numarha ndǝghǝnni ɓagha hǝrghang nda Isǝreela. Ma takhka ɓal, kulo, a weeriya ɓenggǝn mahan tǝ katǝrana ǝnɗa hai ya.
Mbǝ kee mawa, fingya nishya fǝrangnda ǝnwulteena kan. War nda aten kwadɗa ɗǝ a tsar weeriya,
amma nawa nda mǝrrǝghǝn sǝ wa. Ɓa nda ɓa ndang ngganda kan, nanda fathlǝngya Faara, ndaa nda nǝghǝn tǝ yibrha.
Tǝrgha fingya ahur nan ɗǝnda aten kwadɗa ɗǝ ndaa nda nǝghǝn ƙǝla thlǝkna nishyini, amma ndǝghǝn nggi nawa ndan wa.”
Ndangga Yeeso kanda, “Hai, kama tsaunun nurya kee, mani ƙǝɗiina fǝrƙǝkafekkid nun aten ˈya thlǝkna annabiya!
Ashe, kamngwa a sǝsagha Ƙǝrǝsti aten inggini ya a kyagha ahu mamnggitghǝn ɗǝ wa?”
Katǝradghǝn tǝ Musa tǝ annabiya na heu, pǝrang ɗa ndǝn kanda ˈya thlǝkna ɗeleewar Faara aten Ƙǝrǝsti.
Ndusang nanda talɗa fa nanda a ɗǝrha saɗǝ, tsǝgha Yeeso ƙǝla nǝn a mbǝra mbeeɗǝ.
Amma hwanggǝnda kaan tǝ ndaarha, “Tsawu a thlǝman nan, tsǝt figrha hai, kulo yanfaara hǝmɗa hai.” Ɗǝgha ɗǝ tsauka tǝ kanda.
Tsau nǝn hai nǝn a hǝb ǝnnarhami tǝ kanda, tǝranggǝn mburodi sǝ, usa Faara nǝn, kyanggǝn hai fǝranggǝnǝn kanda ɗǝ.
Tǝrgha ingga yindan ɗǝ kukwalangganda hai, a mbǝɗi kee sahadgha ma yindan.
Tsahang mee nda ndan, “Mbǝ tǝk ɗǝm mbǝnda fa ahur nǝm na nǝn a kalang ƙǝmsǝ a kwamana, inang nǝn laɓar Faara ƙǝm hai wa?”
Thliinda sǝ ƙǝkar wuɗa nda Urshelima ɗǝ. A mbǝɗi ɗanda wal Kum Kap Tal ɗi tǝ fingya nafiya wumngga hai.
Nanda a ndaarha, “Ƙǝkafek ni! Chinǝm thliiɗa sǝ har kyaɗang ɗǝ fadghǝn Siman!”
Tǝrgha nafini na sǝri pǝr ǝnɗa nda katǝragha hai a kwamana, tǝ kukwalang nanda hai kyang nǝn mburodi hai.
Yeeso kyaɗang ɗǝ fadghǝn fatsahayighǝn
Kanda ɓal nda a tsǝ laɓara aten ǝnɗi kee, Yeeso tǝ altenggǝn ishgha a maɗufun ndan ndanggǝn kanda, “A fifidɗun hai wa!”
Tǝr ma nda nagha fandan a rǝbrha fa, kanda a numarha mǝnda-mǝnda na nanda.
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Kama tǝrǝm nun? Kama ƙǝm nun a kwana nggi ahur nun?
Kǝla man haryina tǝ saryina. Nggi ni tǝ altenna! Tsuwarama nggi fa nawunun, ƙǝsǝr mǝnda-mǝnda mbǝ thluwa sǝ a fadghǝn tǝ ala ƙǝla nanun nggi tǝghǝn fa wa.”
Thlǝkna Yeeso ǝnɗiya, kyad haryighǝn nǝn tǝ saryighǝn a kanda.
Ko na nanda tǝ wutsǝfayirha fa tǝ ǝnwulteena, ngwalangwanda fǝrƙǝkafek thliiɗa sǝ wa. Tǝrgha tsahang mee nǝn kanda, “Na ǝnnarhami sǝ a har nun a mbǝɗiya wa?”
Fǝrang tǝna nda fifi.
Thlǝghǝnǝn kiigha, kanda a ƙǝlang nda.
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Ənɗa pǝrang ni kun ya nggi ɓalɗǝ tǝ kun. ˈYa na heu ƙǝl ma lǝghǝdɗǝ chirethleng nda hai a tenna ahu ngyakhrha Musa tǝ yi annabiya tǝ ƙǝm Dzabura.”
“Tǝrgha ɗathlanggǝn hutǝn ndan ɗǝ, tǝna nda sǝn ˈya na chichirethlee hai ahu ɗǝleewar Faara.”
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Kulo, ǝnɗi chirethleng na nda hai ya, Ƙǝrǝsti nǝn a sǝsaarha, nǝn a thliirha sǝ hu mǝra a far paara yi mahan.
Mal ɗimiyirha tǝ chakhrǝghǝn ɗǝ nanda a pǝrghǝn ɗǝ ahu thlǝmnggǝn a ƙǝshiirha na heu, nǝn a katǝrarha hai a Urshelima.
Kunni nagha ǝngginiya tǝ yinnun, pǝramadghǝn.
Ɗǝni thlǝnang Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda kun ɓa ndana Pǝpa. Amma tsawama a Urshelima, ƙǝl nggǝlang sǝsǝmnda Faara kun a talara hai.”
Tǝrang nda Yeeso a talara ɗǝ
Kya nǝn sǝ tǝ kanda ma Urshalima ɗǝnda mbǝrha ɗǝ tsau tǝ Mbetani fa, a mbǝɗi haranggǝn haryighǝn sǝ ɗǝfang parka nǝn kanda teena.
Nanǝn a ɗǝfang parka kanda teena, ɗǝkka hai tǝ kanda tǝrang ngganda a talara ɗǝ.
Tǝrgha ɗǝfang shilee nda teena, wuɗa nda a Urshelima ɗǝ lǝlǝgɗa tǝ wutsǝfayirha kaan.
Ka fat paara fa na nda naarha fal Faara ahu Wuri Faara.
